core_obligations: Settle the Noetherian case by quoting the blowup version and noting that blow up squares are almost blow up squares (proof lines 11181-11187).
Descend Y, X -> Y, the open V and the flatness hypothesis to a Noetherian approximation (proof lines 11189-11203).
Apply the Noetherian case to the approximation and base change the resulting diagram back, using stability of almost blow up squares and of the morphism properties (proof lines 11205-11213).
proof_roadmap: Noetherian approximation of the data (proof lines 11189-11203).
Base change back and conclusion (proof lines 11205-11213).
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated Y, X of finite presentation over Y and a quasi-compact open V of Y over which X_V -> V is flat, the lemma produces a commutative diagram whose left and right squares are almost blow up squares, whose lower and top squares are cartesian, with Z cap V empty, and with X' -> Y' flat and of finite presentation (statement lines 11161-11179). The proof first disposes of the Noetherian case by quoting Lemma labelled lemma-flat-after-blowing-up, since blow up squares are almost blow up squares and strict transforms are blowups (proof lines 11181-11187). The general case is reduced to the Noetherian one by absolute Noetherian approximation: Y is written as a directed limit of Noetherian schemes with affine transition morphisms by Limits, Proposition labelled limits-proposition-approximate, then X -> Y is descended to some finite presentation X_i -> Y_i by Limits, Lemma labelled limits-lemma-descend-finite-presentation, V is descended to an open V_i by Limits, Lemma labelled limits-lemma-descend-opens, and flatness of X_{i,V_i} -> V_i is imposed by Limits, Lemma labelled limits-lemma-descend-flat-finite-presentation (proof lines 11189-11203). The Noetherian case applied to X_i -> Y_i with V_i produces a diagram whose base change by Y -> Y_i is the desired one, using preservation of properness, finite presentation, closed immersions and flatness under base change by Morphisms, Lemmas labelled morphisms-lemma-base-change-proper, morphisms-lemma-base-change-finite-presentation, morphisms-lemma-base-change-closed-immersion and morphisms-lemma-base-change-flat, together with the base change stability of almost blow up squares in Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-almost-blow-up (proof lines 11205-11213). Descending the whole configuration to a Noetherian approximation and transporting the almost blowup diagram back along the base change is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
